name: Message
description:
Choose a creature within far range. If you have spoken to the creature before, you do not need to be able to see the creature. You transmit a one-sentence message to the creature, so long as it remains within far range. The creature hears the message in its mind and may respond with a one-sentence reply as a free action within the next round. You hear the response in your mind.

If the creature replies, you may spend 1 MP to send another message and receive another reply within 1 round. You may repeat this as many times as you choose, so long as the creature continues responding.

Describe how you send and receive the messages.

improvements.name: Sending
improvements.description: If you have seen and spoken to a creature before, you may choose it as a target for this spell regardless the distance between it and you.

improvements.name: Telepathy
improvements.description:
If your message successfully reaches the creature and its reply successfully reaches you, you may spend 5 MP to establish a telepathic link with the creature, which lasts for 1 day. You and the creature can instantaneously share words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages with one another through the link.

If the creature has a WITS score of at least 1, it gains the ability to understand the meaning of your words and take in the scope of any sensory messages you send to it.
